words.trans: （文学写法）越过明天这个边界，灾难会继续延伸、没完没了地往未来蔓延；不止"后天那一天"，而是未来很长一段时间
examples: And beyond tomorrow, countless more, as Rufus Clay sold his special brand of terror across the world.

words.trans: v. 胡乱/不耐烦地脱掉；拖着脚走；洗牌
examples: Tom realized he was sweating and shuffled the freezer suit off, throwing it angrily against the wall.

words.trans: adj. 椭圆的（elliptical sweep 椭圆形的旋转轨迹）
examples: At last, with a final elliptical sweep, it came to rest.

words.trans: v. 被（情绪）淹没、压垮；克服（be overcome by sth）
examples: He was overcome by the sight of it, and the flood of memories that it brought.

words.trans: n. 小点、微粒、斑点（a speck of 一小点）
examples: This powder-blue speck on the concrete floor.

words.trans: 短语：勇敢对抗、挺身而出反抗（强者/欺负人者）
examples: He remembered how she had stood up to Snakey.

words.trans: adj. 坚定的、不动摇的（steadfast belief 坚定的信念）
examples: Jim and his kindness and his steadfast belief that Tom might just be right.

words.trans: adj.（英式口语，flaming 的缩写）该死的、要命的（加强情绪的咒骂感叹，无'燃烧'实义）；Flamin' Houdini! 拿传奇逃脱魔术师胡迪尼吐槽对方越狱
examples: Flamin' Houdini! How did he do it?

words.trans: n. 小个子、弱小的家伙（贬义，骂人瘦小）
examples: That's the first thing I'm gonna get out of that runt when I catch him!

words.trans: adj. 体能差的、体格不强健的（fit 的反义）
examples: It was the unfit one from before.

words.trans: 习语：脑子糊涂、傻、脑子进水（字面"脑袋软软的"，形容人愚蠢、做事没脑子）
examples: But who would be so soft in the head to do that?

words.trans: 习语：处在某人的处境、设身处地（字面'穿着别人的鞋子'）
examples: I wouldn't want to be in their shoes by the time Mike finishes with them.

words.trans: ①收拾、惩罚、狠狠对付某人（带伤害/报复意味）；②和某人断绝关系/分手；finish with sth 用完某物、不再使用
examples: I wouldn't want to be in their shoes by the time Mike finishes with them.

words.trans: v. 集合、召集、聚集（召集会议/队伍）
examples: Abort search and convene by muster point.

words.trans: 短语：集合点、集结点（军事用语 muster 点集合）
examples: All units: abort search and convene by muster point.

words.trans: n. 逃犯、逃亡者
examples: Fugitive has been identified escaping south from base.

words.trans: 口语（无线电通讯用语）：收到、明白（= message received）
examples: 'Roger that,' was the last he heard from the men.

words.trans: v. 笨手笨脚地摸索、胡乱摆弄
examples: He began to fumble manically with the lid, but it was too late.

words.trans: adv. 发狂似地、慌乱失控地
examples: He began to fumble manically with the lid.

words.trans: 情态动词 have done：对过去事情的推测——想必是、一定是（must have been 想必曾是）
examples: It must have been some kind of ventilation shaft but there was no ladder up.

words.trans: v. 发光、照射；把光对准某个方向（shine the light along... 把光沿着……照过去）
examples: He was able to shine the light along the tunnel itself.

words.trans: 短语：大约、左右（数量后）
examples: After another dozen or so rungs his shoes filled with water.

words.trans: v. 轻抚、柔和地反复摩挲（轻柔持续来回拂过，不是猛撞）
examples: Little wavelets stroking the bottom of his chin.

words.trans: 短语：松开、放开（手里抓着的东西）、不再攥着
examples: He let go of the ladder and the current grabbed him.

words.trans: adj. 迷失方向的、晕头转向的
examples: He was disorientated for a moment, drifting backwards.

words.trans: （splutter 现在分词）呛水、噗噗地吐水；气急败坏地说话
examples: He came up again, spluttering.

words.trans: 鼻腔后部，即鼻咽部（鼻子和咽喉连通的深处，不是外面鼻梁后面）
examples: The earthy-tasting water stinging the back of his nose.

words.trans: 短语：被拖着向前走、往前漂
examples: He let himself go, pulled along with the current.

words.trans: 短语：蜷起、收拢起来（把肢体收起贴近躯干、减少占用空间）
examples: His legs tucked up under him.

words.trans: adv. 赌气地、心怀恶意地
examples: The little island at the quieter end of the lake that he had spitefully kept secret from them.

words.trans: n. 衬砌、内壁、衬层；concrete lining（隧道/井道内壁浇筑的）混凝土内衬（工程用词）
examples: The rough concrete lining of the tunnel there was covered in lichens.

words.trans: adj. 用砖砌壁的、内衬砖块的（line=做内衬，-lined 形容词后缀）
examples: He looked up into a brick-lined opening twelve feet high.

words.trans: n. 通风、换气；通风系统（ventilation shaft 通风竖井）
examples: It must have been some kind of ventilation shaft.

words.trans: n.（lichen 复数）地衣
examples: The lining was covered in lichens and liverworts.

words.trans: n.（植物）苔类、叶苔
examples: The lining was covered in lichens and liverworts.

words.trans: n.（fern 复数）蕨类植物
examples: The metal grille at the top was framed by ferns and mosses.

words.trans: n. 召唤、感召；（法律）传票（a summons from... 来自……的召唤）
examples: It was like a summons from another world and he almost choked at the sight.

words.trans: n. 水闸、泄水道；sluice gate 水闸、泄水闸门
examples: There was a metal sluice gate with a curtain of water rushing over.

words.trans: 短语：水闸、泄水闸门
examples: He grabbed hold of the sluice gate and felt the force of the water pulling him away.

words.trans: adj. 欢欣鼓舞的、凯旋般的、得意洋洋的
examples: Then the bumps and bends and the triumphant splash.

words.trans: n. 氯、氯气（泳池消毒水的刺鼻味）
examples: Followed by the chlorine sting in his throat.

words.trans: n. 漂浮的残骸、漂流物
examples: He was flotsam in a whirlpool.

words.trans: v. 倒抽一口气、喘息、急促吸气；n. 倒抽的一口气（gasp for breath 喘气）
examples: He smashed back on the concrete bottom again, gasping for breath in the spray.

words.trans: adj. 流动的、流体的、不固定的；n. 液体、流体
examples: Ahead there was a faint fluid light.

words.trans: v. 刮擦、蹭、摩擦（发出刺耳声）；n. 刮痕、擦伤
examples: The current pushed him on from behind, his head scraping the ceiling.

words.trans: v. 渗透、缓缓透入（光线/声音 filter in 透进来）
examples: The green light was filtering into the tunnel from somewhere outside.

words.trans: n. 河鲈（一种淡水鱼）；v.（鸟）栖息、落在高处
examples: He stretched out towards it, like a perch hungry for prey.

words.trans: adj. 微微闪烁的、泛着粼粼微光的
examples: He could make out the shimmering shape of an arch.

words.trans: 短语：重重猛撞到……上面
examples: He was slamming up against the metal bars, grabbing them with both hands.

words.trans: n.（sinus 复数）鼻窦（呛水后刺痛的位置）
examples: He shook them, his sinuses stinging.

words.trans: n. 针扎般细小的点、针刺小孔（pinpricks of light 点点微光）
examples: Pinpricks of light stabbed at the back of his eyes.

words.trans: （flail 现在分词）胡乱挥舞（四肢）、乱扑腾
examples: He could hear his heart thumping, see his desperate hands flailing in front of his face.

words.trans: n.（名词）卡扣、锁扣、搭扣（a metal catch 固定闸门的金属搭扣）
examples: Then he saw a metal catch holding the gate in place.

words.trans: n. 毛孔、小孔、细孔；v. 仔细研读、认真审视（pore over）
examples: Oh, the kind, kind air, light filling every pore.

words.trans: 文学化短语：大口贪婪地吸气（grab greedy breaths into hot lungs）
examples: He burst through the surface, grabbing greedy breaths into hot lungs.

words.word: There was nothing sb could do to do sth
words.trans: 句式（定语从句，that 省略）：某人无论如何都做不到……；毫无办法去做……
examples: There was nothing he could do to make himself enter that shaft.
words.key: There was nothing sb could do to do sth

words.trans: 短语：属于其本身独有的（energy all of its own 一股属于它自己的能量）
examples: A tiny blur, spinning with an energy all of its own.

words.trans: 短语：接受某人本来的样子、接纳真实的他，不试图改变他
examples: How both Maggie and Joel took him as he was.

words.trans: 比喻习语：内心一盏灯亮了、恍然大悟、心里突然想通了（字面'打开灯'，实指顿悟）
examples: He looked at Maggie's button now, and a light went on inside.

words.trans: 短语：改变主意、心生悔意、开始犹豫（字面"产生第二种想法"→反悔、打退堂鼓）
examples: Without giving himself time to have second thoughts, he climbed over the gate.

words.trans: 短语：一刹那、转瞬之间（split 劈开→劈开的一瞬间）
examples: He felt weightless for a split second.

words.trans: （比喻）死亡滑道（指管道像水上乐园的死亡滑道一样）
examples: As the pipe curved over like a death slide, he lost contact with the bottom.

words.trans: （小说高频）就是这一刻！终于到了！——不是"这就是它"
examples: This was it, the final triple horror: imprisoned, underground and now underwater.
